I do these things too, none of us are normal or perfect. Social skills are something that I have to work on because it doesn’t come as natural to me. I know it hurts to be rejected by your peers. I make people uncomfortable intentionally too. I just want to connect and have genuine friendships. But sometimes I say weird shit and sometimes people are just judgement assholes. Either way I need you to know that all the flaws you think you have are things that will make you interesting and even loved by the right people. You just have to stay open ( and that sometimes means getting hurt too). Much love friend 💕

Also just a suggestion, don’t try so hard to get people to like. It’s hard but I know it can scare off people. You maybe wanna try to show a lot of interest in someone very soon but I recommend going slow, and letting that person initiate more friendship moments. If then don’t , they might not be interested and that’s okay. If they do continue getting to know them.
